name: El Paso Willcox Lateral
researcher_notes: Not a match to an existing row: P0184 El Paso Gas Pipeline is the whole-system row (no start/end, 10,140 mi) and no roster row covers the Willcox to border lateral; expansion rows P2577/P2617/P3190 are other projects. Shaped as an expansion-style row under the parent PipelineName per rule (e). Confirmed: EIA Aug 2026 release, sheet 'Historical Projects (1996-2024)', Excel row 194: El Paso Willcox Lateral, El Paso Natural Gas, Completed, in service 2001-09-01, AZ,MX, 68 mi, 130 MMcf/d, 16 and 20 in, interstate, FERC docket CP99-322/323. A 2000 Natural Gas Intelligence article (page loads via verifier; direct curl is blocked) reports FERC approval of a 60-mile, 130 MMcf/d lateral with 56 miles of 20 inch from Willcox to the border. 56 vs 68 mi: the 68 figure in EIA likely includes the two 16 inch branches; staged EIA's 68 mi, noted the 56 mi trunk. EIA and NGI are not fully independent on dimensions (tier medium-high, independent flag false); FERC order of Feb 9 2000 (CP99-322/323) not opened as a document. Length 68 mi is about 109 km, over the 25 km rule. Owner/operator not staged: EIA names El Paso Natural Gas; roster P0184 carries Kinder Morgan [100%] and parent Kinder Morgan Inc, no ref for that link found here, so left to owners tab. Route: none located; official GIS not searched beyond this; set no route, route research left to the routes leg. Verifier note: the 2000 NGI page text is not readable by curl (403), so the 56 mi detail comes from the evidence note and a search summary; the ref cell for diameter/location rests on EIA first. No cost stated.
